title: Article 287 — Exemption from taxes on electricity

content.study:
Topic at a Glance
Article 287 of the Constitution of India is titled “Exemption from taxes on electricity”. It forms an integral component of Finance, Property, Contracts and Suits (Articles 264–300A), located within the “Finance” cluster. Current through the 106th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2023.

Constitutional Text & Anatomy
Save in so far as Parliament may by law otherwise provide, no law of a State shall impose, or authorise the imposition of, a tax on the consumption or sale of electricity . . for \
